note: CLI / CI baseline — 更新发版前请同步
raw:
---
name: release-inspector
description: 发布前巡检 — 检查 URL 能否上线
triggers:
  - 上线
  - 巡检
  - 验收
tools:
  - http_probe
  - knowledge_search
steps:
  - id: probe
    label: http_probe · 探活
    tool: http_probe
    args:
      url: "{{probeUrl}}"
  - id: search
    label: knowledge_search · 规范召回
    tool: knowledge_search
    args:
      query: "{{query}}"
      topK: 3
  - id: compose
    label: 合成巡检报告
    tool: __compose_release__
    args:
      probe: $probeResult
      hits: $searchResult
---
